description: MainActivity.kt defines an Android activity that generates and displays a 5-color palette using HSL color space. It includes UI elements such as color tiles, labels, copy buttons, and a floating action button to regenerate colors, along with methods for color manipulation and clipboard operations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that generates, displays, and manages a 5-color palette with copy functionality and regeneration via a floating button.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets up event listeners, and generates the initial color palette.

methods.name: populateRandomPalette
methods.description: Generates a new set of five random colors in HSL space, converts them to color ints and hex codes, and updates the UI tiles.

methods.name: applyTile
methods.description: Applies a color and its hex code to a specific tile, adjusting contrast and setting copy button behavior.

methods.name: hslToColor
methods.description: Converts HSL values to Android color integer.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a color integer to a hexadecimal color string.

methods.name: isColorDark
methods.description: Determines if a color is dark based on luminance, for accessibility contrast adjustments.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to the system clipboard.
